sections.gist: NVIDIA's official throughput optimization of DeepSeek R1 on Blackwell GPUs increased TPS/GPU from approximately 2,000 to **4,600** (ISL/OSL 1K/2K), achieving a **2.3×** improvement.

sections.heading: 3. TMA Practical Experience and Pitfalls
